# Script paths tools/collate_gsc.py must never collate, and that
# tools/verify_gsc_collation.py must not treat as regressions when the
# pre-collation three-root configuration still resolves them.
#
# Syntax: one pattern per line, '#' starts a comment, paths are the loader's
# relative module paths with '/' separators and are matched case-insensitively.
# "<dir>/**" excludes everything under <dir>; otherwise fnmatch applies.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IW4 player-character model chain.  CoDOL composes player appearance from the
# player's own playerdata character record (maps/mp/gametypes/_teams.gsc
# playerModelForWeapon -> codol_applyProfileCharacter / codol_applyBotCharacter,
# resolved natively in src/online/assets/character_composition.c against
# mp/coMarketplaceItems.csv, mp/coCharacterDefTable.csv and
# mp/coCharItems/<part>.csv).  The IW4 team-character path is therefore not a
# model source: mptype\mptype_*::precache -> character\*::precache ->
# xmodelalias\alias_*::main only precached IW4 xmodels that no CoDOL zone
# contains, which is where the "xmodel not in any mounted zone; using void"
# warnings came from.  _teams.gsc no longer references any of them, and nothing
# else in the MP/coop/zm chain does either: the only other referrers are
# aitype/*.gsc, which no reachable script loads.
character/**
# ...except the attack-dogs AI character. aitype/enemy_dog_mp.gsc is loaded by
# NATIVE code now (src/online/player/actor_scripts.cpp resolves the aitype
# main/precache/spawner during the map script-load phase), so the note above
# that "the only other referrers are aitype/*.gsc, which no reachable script
# loads" no longer holds for this one file. It precaches german_sheperd_dog,
# which C1 does ship (common_gametype_mp.zone xmodel #10079).
!character/character_mp_german_shepherd.gsc
mptype/**
xmodelalias/**
